problem_statement: Synthetic test: Disconnected court metadata (P01) and rural legal-aid directories (P03) hinder targeting of underserved districts.
evidence_summary: Synthetic integration test across D01, D06, and D07.
legal_basis: UU No. 16 Tahun 2011 tentang Bantuan Hukum; UU No. 14 Tahun 2008 (KIP)
institutional_competence: BPHN (Kemenkumham) and Mahkamah Agung RI (advisory proposal only; no institutional representation)
policy_option: Publish standardized BPS-coded court and OBH interoperability tables.
implementation_requirements: Human review Gate 4 & Gate 6; verified court address reconciliation.
resource_assumptions: Low-cost open-source ETL using existing public directories.
risks: Stale legacy addresses (8 pending in P03 DS02).
expected_outcomes: Improved identification of legal-aid deserts (proposition to test).
evaluation_method: Coverage audit against Kemendesa Indeks Desa 2025.
